item.title: Loveland council to consider Costco deal, 25-year tax share agreement
item.description: On Tuesday, the council will consider a business assistance agreement with Realberry (formerly known as McWhinney Real Estate Services) aimed at bringing Costco and about 300 jobs to east Loveland, in exchange for up to 25 years of sales tax sharing and help with construction of public improvements.

item.title: Gold for Elana! Meyers Taylor, 41, wins Olympic monobob title at Milan Cortina Games
item.description: The 41-year-old U.S. bobsledder — a mother of two special-needs children, an athlete whose career was jeopardized by concussions, someone who dealt with plenty of doubt in recent years — is, finally, an Olympic champion.
